Module com.univalle.sudoku
Package com.example.sudoku.view

Class GameView

java.lang.Object
javafx.stage.Window
javafx.stage.Stage
com.example.sudoku.view.GameView
All Implemented Interfaces:
IGameView, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class GameView extends javafx.stage.Stage implements IGameView
Singleton stage that acts as the primary window for the Sudoku game. Loads game-view.fxml, applies the scene, and configures the window.

Implements IGameView to expose the minimal lifecycle surface required by the MVC architecture.
